sectionSubtitle: The small practices that shape how I learn, build, and improve.

traits.title: Curious Notes
traits.description: I follow questions, inspect details, and turn new discoveries into something I can use.

traits.title: Break It Down
traits.description: I make complex problems less intimidating by working through one practical piece at a time.

traits.title: Daily Learning
traits.description: I make room for steady practice because small study sessions compound into real progress.

traits.title: Creative Builds
traits.description: I enjoy giving useful interfaces personality, clarity, and a little spark.

traits.title: Quality Checks
traits.description: I test, review, and refine so an idea becomes an experience people can trust.

traits.title: Good Energy
traits.description: I bring focus and optimism to every experiment, assignment, and build log entry.
